fullContentHtml:
RSSB 4th Class Group D Revised Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) | RSMSSB has released the revised result for the post of Group-D. This recruitment was released for 53,749 posts. Applications for the RSSB Group-D Recruitment 2025 were accepted from March 21, 2025, to April 19, 2025. The online examination was held on 19, 20 & 21 September 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RSSB 4th Class Group D Revised Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 21 March 2025
  • Last Date : 19 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 April 2025
  • Exam Date : 19, 20, 21 September 2025
  • Admit Card : 12 September 2025
  • Question Paper : 21 September 2025
  • Answer Key : 17 October 2025
  • Result : 16 January 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 21 January 2026
  • Result/ Score Card : 26 January 2026
  • Revised Result : 29 June 2026 (Update)

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
